title: Police in Karnataka prevent Andhra Pradesh Congress Committee chief Y.S. Sharmila from entering disputed property
description: The North East Division police of Bengaluru on Sunday stopped Y.S. Sharmila, president of the Andhra Pradesh Congress Committee and sister of YSRCP chief and former Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister Y.S. Jagan Mohan Reddy, from entering a disputed property in Yelahanka, citing an interim injunction order issued by a court in Devanahalli
